body:
Rheos is evolving toward a content management and review loop: open a document, discuss it, and review an edit. Markdown is primary; compatible volatile/API/raw inputs may supply document maps without becoming stored files. This PR adds portable Alpha admission laws, a proposed brief and bounded planning cards. It implements no production provider or complete CMS interface.

Current root head: `0fdeb010174de5169984b9c841ab0d32f10d7147`.

`alpha.law.document` checks document/observation/assembly shapes, portability, supplied source context and declared schemas. Source identity compares type, ID and optional revision while preserving extension maps. These laws do not execute assembly, establish digest/freshness truth, authorize writes or persist provider payloads. The identity regression failed before repair, then passed JVM27tests/107assertions and compiledCLJS6tests/49assertions; lint0errors/warnings.

The eleven-point epic contains Alpha3, Rheos5 and Epiphany3 stories. Authoritative Rheos history is tracked: epic incoming, Alpha and Rheos in review, Epiphany ready for prospective independent design review. Separate incoming diagnostic, YAML-reuse, CI and review-admission cards grant no additional readiness. The Alpha note-rendering repair uses an actual Rheos comment operation and declared Marked rendering; it preserves the original note as a paragraph, changing no Alpha law or acceptance state. Root card changes distinguish complete trusted loads before every mutation and existing checked-value reuse from remaining qualification work.

[Rheos #1](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/1), current `e634b40da8e5da7e1364138e703e052ca4f5b47b`, repairs targeted YAML source preservation, visible projection-aware refusal, comment headers, portable source/edit boundaries, update admission and native collection-cycle refusal. The latest native MiMo5401618354 defects were independently reproduced and repaired: created quoted/backslash titles could poison subsequent loads, and collection priority/status produced unnamed errors. Creation now escapes strings and validates decoded frontmatter before effects; decoded title/priority/status refusals name the field and source. Independent review caught and repaired UTF-16 substitution during UTF-8 persistence. Ordinary red→green→supplemental red→green commits retain actual contexts; no general Markdown-body losslessness or HTTP status change is claimed.

Both prepared source qualification and fresh hosted run37139221794/artifact11279822952 pass **186tests/1176assertions** twice, lint0errors/0warnings/eight unchanged infos and four zero-warning releases/nonempty outputs. Hosted evidence verifies all nine attempted gates0/errors empty, exact clean e634, complete221-package unlocked install and pinned21protocol/10chat source bootstrap. Prepared Node24/shadow3.4.10 and hostedNode22/shadow3.5.4 are distinct. Source attempt1 failed the separate Muse context job on Maven403 before model review; one failed-jobs-only retry passed context compilation, reusing the successful deterministic evidence. Fresh native [MiMo review5401907875](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5401907875) APPROVED exact e634 with no confirmed findings. Its complete untruncated118484-byte input has29Git file headers; the index reports27 because it excludes two deleted-only files. The trace requests all2207diff lines across four bounded reads. Preceding-head approvals remain historical. Verified repairs settle both confirmed inline findings and the whole-body request in writer comment5971562315. Raw red/green logs, all44source hashes and hosted inspection are retained under `.ημ/diagnostics/rheos-create-core-repair-e634b40-20261003/` and `rheos-hosted-gates-e634b40-20261003/`.

[Rheos #2](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/2), current `4a38902520b5e34ef66aa9d440f15ab9d97e3efe` stacked on e634, owns solely a231-line CI plan. It specifies frozen-install sequencing, source guards, bounded estimates and canonical planning exit. Durable-evidence repair links original baseline artifacts preserved in Foresighta167d66 and requires publication before receipt citation. Current hosted run37139274990/artifact11279188999 independently passes all nine gates at exact clean4a with186/1176twice, lint and all four releases. Fresh native MiMo5401833203 APPROVED the complete231-line plan with no confirmed findings. Its offline external-link note is answered in [independent artifact verification](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/2#issuecomment-5971845658): all four pinned GitHub blobs, raw log hashes and retained baseline outputs match. This does not supply human planning acceptance; preceding5401617276 actually reviewed e18, regardless of mutable REST commit metadata. The standalone workflow and committed lockfile remain planned; implementation readiness and configured planning convergence are not established.

[Epiphany #1](https://github.com/riatzukiza/epiphany/pull/1), current `a5e70b20f11c9b2f3c7aad552a46bc51fbe06a28`, proposes source, assembly, review, retention and provider boundaries. Generated projection policy is repaired: ignored/untracked snapshot, preserved local/history bytes, durable tracked Rheos events. Its caller provides complete554325-byte input beside bounded300062-byte primary. Hosted run37129718053 passes exact/clean input gates. Current-head MiMo5401303866 APPROVED after reviewing all ten files and recovering omitted card/research source. The remaining status-body disposition still lacks authenticated exact-head independent scoped agreement. No provider implementation or completed configured review round is claimed.

Foresight's caller retains bounded primary input, a complete immutable-base/head supplement with hash/prefix checks, all thirteen deterministic gate commands and exact-clean guards. Prior0b run37135388393 verified complete485444-byte/49-file input: twelve gates passed; receipt_history exited2. Model execution produced REQUEST_CHANGES but final validation rejected raw Git-quoted Unicode paths and skipped native publication. Actual receipts/Alpha recovery was demonstrated; whole49-file consumption was not. That failed attempt is preserved under `.ημ/diagnostics/foresight-native-publication-0b182c8-20261003/`.

This head selects existing [Muse PR18](https://github.com/octave-commons/muse/pull/18)'s independently qualified, explicitly unmerged `19456bb4c5f4d5ce1ac52ca854221516302e0c2e` through the reusable workflow's supported muse_revision input. It decodes paths in the owning Muse parser and retains strict GitHub filename enforcement. Actual replay accepts both previously rejected root locations, rejects literal quoted aliases and refuses malformed inputs. Hosted202tests/546assertions, four builds, three cold builds and lint pass. Reused compiled-tool bytes match57candidate source/plugin/publisher files; no fresh local compilation or accepted-law promotion is claimed. No caller parser/restaging workaround is added; primary-only and deletion-only indexing limits remain. Caller actionlint/diff hygiene pass, and all13gate-script bytes are unchanged. Current run37140607115 verifies exact clean0f, complete605344-byte/64-file input and a correctly bounded300062-byte primary. The Muse candidate compiles107files/57compiled/0warnings, preserving the strict publisher. All13semantic gates are attempted:12pass and receipt_history exits2 with the unchanged base-prefix refusal. The model job ended cancelled at18:14:30UTC; GitHub explicitly records that it exceeded45minutes. The final OpenCode evidence-review gate failed. Attempt artifact11281386474 is retained with verified native digest9565861ce7ee9711a137db2a3b9e12027d39994c97afdddc19bacd7eb60dd57a. It contains only partial model stdout/stderr, with no submission or completed classification. Supplementary Alpha source was recovered, but later cards/content-loop source lack demonstrated review completion. No native review was published; the cancelled attempt supplies no approval or full-round credit. Runner jobs reporting success do not make the receipt semantic failure pass.

The existing receipt law now independently confirms **22historical malformed envelopes:11already in base and11branch-added**. Raw line hashes and membership are preserved under `.ημ/diagnostics/receipt-shapes-0b182c8-20261003/`. The strict base-prefix check also rejects a prior ordinary merge with divergent append histories. CodeRabbit's P1 remains unfixed. This head preserves previous receipt/reflection/event prefixes and appends a valid vector envelope; it does not correct, reorder, coerce, grandfather or waive the historical records. A reviewed correction/admission mechanism remains necessary.

Native reviewers authenticate using the configured GitHub App on the personal forks. Current native verdicts, deterministic results, input availability and review convergence remain separate. Configured Codex quota is exhausted; no completed full configured-agent round is claimed. A temporary CodeRabbit charge/mode message was later removed, so an account transaction remains unverified; further manual requests await billing preference. Auto-merge is off; no merge, hosting or evidence-gate waiver is asserted.
